method.name: Spatial vertex clustering with source triangle remapping
method.retained: All provided skin, cortical gyri, thalami, pons, medulla, cerebellum surfaces
method.limitations: Source-derived spatially clustered display surfaces; not patient-specific, histology-registered, or watertight simulation geometry. The imported skin retains the earlier upper-body crop. No new cross sections or clipping windows are introduced.
